collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2006 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2006 Onwards (906) requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Sprinter which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
